title: OSCToM：基于强化学习引导的对抗生成实现高阶心智理论
summary: 提出OSCToM方法，通过强化学习、领域特定语言和组合代理模型生成观察者-自我冲突，以测试LLM在高阶心智理论任务中的递归信念推理能力。在FANToM基准上达到76%准确率，数据合成效率提升6倍。
summary_en: Proposes OSCToM, combining RL, domain-specific language, and compositional surrogate models to generate observer-self conflicts for testing LLM's recursive belief reasoning in high-order Theory of Mind tasks. Achieves 76% accuracy on FANToM benchmark with 6x data synthesis efficiency.
